stories.story_fr: Le revenu net du premier trimestre 2026 a chuté à 531 millions de dollars, contre 1 436 millions l’an précédent.
stories.story_en: First‑quarter 2026 net income fell to $531 million, down from $1,436 million a year ago.
stories.quote: first-quarter net income of $531 million, or $1.38 per share, compared to net income of $1,436 million, or $3.73 per share, in the first quarter of last year.

stories.story_fr: Plus de 7 000 miles de conducteur couvert ont été installés dans les zones à haut risque d’incendie, soit plus de 90 % du plan de durcissement du réseau.
stories.story_en: More than 7,000 miles of covered conductor have been installed in high‑fire‑risk areas, representing over 90 % of the grid‑hardening plan.
stories.quote: installation of more than 7,000 miles of covered conductor in high fire risk areas—over 90% of the utility’s planned grid hardening effort

stories.story_fr: SCE poursuit le programme de compensation pour la récupération après les incendies, en traitant activement les réclamations et en effectuant des paiements rapides et équitables.
stories.story_en: SCE continues its Wildfire Recovery Compensation Program, actively processing claims and making fast, fair payments.
stories.quote: SCE remains committed to administering the program in a transparent way that is responsive to community needs with fast and fair payments

stories.story_fr: Edison International a confirmé ses prévisions de core EPS 2026 entre 5,90 $ et 6,20 $, soulignant la confiance dans la croissance prévue de 5‑7 % d’ici 2030.
stories.story_en: Edison International affirmed its 2026 core EPS guidance of $5.90‑$6.20, underscoring confidence in the projected 5‑7 % growth through 2030.

stories.story_fr: La décision finale du General Rate Case 2025 a été adoptée, augmentant les revenus et soutenant la performance EPS de SCE.
stories.story_en: The final decision of the 2025 General Rate Case was adopted, boosting revenues and supporting SCE’s EPS performance.
stories.quote: adoption of the 2025 GRC final decision in the third quarter of 2025, partially offset by the absence of a benefit to interest expense
